The Saudi-led coalition says it has intercepted and destroyed an incoming Houthi ballistic missile over Riyadh, while the Iran-backed group warns travellers to avoid the Saudi capital’s international airport, declaring it an unsafe military target.
US President Donald Trump says the US is considering a possible attack on Iran as soon as Sunday, pointing out that Washington might have to “finish the job” or could reach a deal with Tehran.
